intro_en: Kreupasanam is a Marian retreat centre and pilgrimage shrine at Kalavoor in Alappuzha district, Kerala. The name means 'Seat of Grace.' Pilgrims come to pray before the image of Kreupasanam Mathavu, seeking reconciliation, healing, peace for their families, and the fulfillment of the Marian Covenant under the motherly care of the Blessed Virgin Mary.
prayer_morning_en:
Mother, Holy Mother, the Mother of God, please have our heartfelt gratitude for all the blessings and graces received through Kreupasanam by us and our country by Mother's most amazingly powerful intercession.

Mother, Holy Mother, the Mother of God, may the study report on your apparition, prophesies or miracles at Kalavoor, Kreupasanam Marian Retreat Centre, which occurred in the year 2004 – on 7th December, 2.30 P.M. in the afternoon, may get ecclesiastical approval after having studied and examined the things that fall or relate to question of facts, evidence and above all the question of theology, so that the fact about the loving, concern and affectionate care of Blessed Mother manifested in the Kreupasanam apparition, as the protector and the defender of all those who are in unnecessary sufferings and degradation across our world, and Mother as the Queen of the Prophets, The Ark of the Covenant, The Mother of Heavens and earth and The comforter of afflicted, the devotion to the Mother Mary may become the universal catholic as including all, embracing all, concluding so that all those in the margins of society may recognize Christ in their painful stories by witnessing to the Good News of justice and compassion, so that our families may become better families, fuller families free from want, fear, disease and above all sin.

Mother, Holy Mother, the Queen of Heaven and Earth, may the Holy Catholic Church dedicate the entire universe with its cosmic process to you, O Holy Mother, to your Kreupasanam apparition so we pray. Holy Mother, the Mother of Rosary, in union with all the prayers of Kreupasanam, the intentions of this family be granted (mention the intention or the prayer request) in this blessed and joyful moment of thy apparition. Amen.

1 Credo, 7 Our Father, 7 Hail Mary
prayer_evening_en:
Kreupasanam Covenant - Evening Prayer
Marian Covenant Prayer - Kreupasanam Prayer

(After Evening Family Prayer - Light Candle Prayer at Kreupasanam Marian Shrine)

Holy Mother, the Kreupasanam Mother of Grace, please empower me to fulfill the Marian Covenant Prayer which I oathed in thy holy presence. My prayer requests kindly be granted with all those who participate in the online Marian Covenant Prayer with their intentions.

1 Our Father, 1 Hail Mary

Holy Mother, the Kreupasanam Mother of Grace, please help our family to fulfill the covenant we had made in thy presence. With the intentions of those who participate in the Monday and Tuesday Marian Covenant Retreats, let my family's intentions also be granted.

1 Our Father, 1 Hail Mary

Holy Mother, the Kreupasanam Mother of Grace, please help me to comply with the covenant I had made before you, O Holy Mother, for my family. With the prayer intentions of all those who participate in the residential Marian retreat and second Saturday Marian Covenant retreat at Kreupasanam, let my family's prayer requests also be kindly granted.

1 Our Father, 1 Hail Mary

Say 1 Credo, 1 Our Father & 1 Hail Mary after the Covenant Prayer

intentions_en: For healing of body, mind and spirit
For peace and reconciliation in families
For those facing financial hardship and unemployment
For children and young people growing in faith
For the sick, the lonely and the dying
In thanksgiving for graces received through Kreupasanam
